title: Canonical stalk maps commute with nested open inclusions
statement: Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $y\in Y$, and let $U\subseteq V\subseteq Y$ be opens containing $y$. The canonical maps from $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ to these opens satisfy $U.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y);(U\hookrightarrow V)=V.\mathrm{fromSpecStalkOfMem}(y)$.

source.place: Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι, line 176; applied to U and V and cancelled along V.ι

proof.text: Compose with the open immersion V.ι. Associativity and Scheme.homOfLE_ι identify the left composite with U.fromSpecStalkOfMem followed by U.ι. Mathlib Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι identifies both composites with Y.fromSpecStalk y. Cancel the monomorphism V.ι.

proof_origin.place: Three-line specialization of Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι; extracted from the comparison definition in the second reading.

mathlib_searches.query: Canonical maps from the spectrum of a scheme stalk commute with inclusions of nested open neighborhoods
The canonical map from the spectrum of a stalk to a smaller open composed with inclusion into a larger open equals the canonical stalk map to the larger open
